# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is described as a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face. When entering church with his bride, he beams with pride and happiness.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Personality

Billy is stolid, stupid, good-natured, and perpetually smiling. He suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts and is extremely shy, especially regarding courtship. Despite his shyness, he can be puffed up with pride on occasion. He is considered a good fellow with no bad habits.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## History

Billy drove Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and his sister Jane Andrews to a concert in White Sands in their double-seated buggy. During the trip, he insisted that Anne ride on the front seat beside him because he admired her immensely. Following the concert, he ran off out of mortal fear of being invited to the social supper inside, but waited outside with the team to drive the girls back home. Later, after his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, Billy wished to marry Anne Shirley. Due to his extreme shyness, he badgered his sister Jane into proposing to Anne on his behalf, offering to wait until Anne finished college if necessary. After Anne declined the proposal, Billy did not break his heart and instead married Nettie Blewett, whom his mother favored as a good manager. They made their official married appearance together at the Avonlea church.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
